items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: he was the manager of the Yelping Hounds... And Buster Meehy... phoned up a band around there... I know you heard talk of those guys who used to play so much trumpet... he used to play with us too

ctx.x: Well who was in the Yelping Hounds? I never remember.

I'd gone and he was the manager of the Yelping Hounds, he was a tennis action phone player. And Buster Meehy, well they was booting his buddies out of Texas, out of Houston, well they left there and come on back and phoned up a band around there. And then they had another little ordinary band, Sun Shields, he had a little get together, out there around there too. Well there's two little minor bands and I know you heard talk of those guys who used to play so much trumpet, they, let's see what, he got, Kilt used to…
Is he the one that got killed by this convict? Yeah, E. Van Thomas. E. Van, that's it.
